overview: You were at the Theatre for the rehearsal at nine. The plot's title was turned away. Two hired men were in the tiring-house from the night, and the chain was off the gate for the morning. You did not put a play's name on the strip in your hand.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Rehearsed at nine and left the title turned.
